metadata.description: Exact check: is random eviction needed?
metadata.dataset_justification: No external dataset is used, and none should be: uniformity of a reservoir sampler is a statement about INDEX k-subsets, so the canonical stream is the integer sequence 1..n, generated in-script. The empty depends_on is deliberate, not an omission.

determinism.exact_dp_and_fibermap: no randomness whatsoever; outputs are bit-identical by construction
determinism.rng: numpy Generator(PCG64), seeded per (panel, candidate) by crc32 of the candidate key

justification.main: S1 (sum-mod-k + minimal flow repair) and S1f (flow-optimal) are EXACTLY uniform at every prefix of every screened and held-out cell (screen pass=True, held-out pass=True); the minimum eviction entropy is EXACTLY 0 on every step with k | (i+1) (14/41 steps, zero_on_divisible=True), where the deterministic sum-mod-k rule is already perfectly balanced (summodk_perfect_on_divisible=True); on the remaining steps the minimum decays like k/(i-k) -- at most 0.333 x log2(k) once i >= 2k, and reaching 1.000 x log2(k) only at the degenerate first step i = k, where a single source (the whole reservoir [k]) must split across all k children and the classical uniform rule is already optimal. Overall 80.5% of the 41 analysed steps sit at or below 0.25 x log2(k). Summed over the whole stream this is a CONSTANT-in-n eviction budget: the analytic upper bound is 20.8 bits at k=10 whether n is 1e4 or 1e6, against the classical k*log2(k)*ln(n/k) which grows to 380.8 bits at n=1e6.
justification.c1: S5-CIRC has EXACTLY uniform first-order inclusion probabilities at every prefix (incl_maxdev == 0 exactly) with a support of only i of the C(i,k) subsets, so its exact total variation from uniform is 1 - i/C(i,k). At the held-out scale (n=1000, k=10, T=1e6) the standard first-order max-deviation test does not flag it (flagged=False) while the pairwise co-inclusion test does, at log10(p)=-204954.964639326 (98.2% of item pairs are never co-sampled at all). Crucially the blindness is not a power problem: the ANYTIME first-order test, which checks every prefix rather than only the final reservoir, misses it in every matched cell too, because S5-CIRC's inclusion probabilities are exactly k/i at every prefix by a counting argument -- each item lies in exactly k of the i circular windows.

numbers_that_moved.quantity: prefix at which the FIFO control first fails, k=2
numbers_that_moved.explanation: at prefix i=2 the reservoir is {1,2} with 1 the oldest, so on acceptance FIFO always yields {2,3} and never {1,3}; the deviation is already maximal at i=3

numbers_that_moved.quantity: relative max deviation of unrepaired sum-mod-k at its first failing prefix, k=4
numbers_that_moved.explanation: the exact DP gives m1_rel = k-1 at the first failing prefix i=k+1, because the single source [k] must send all of its accepted mass to one of its k children

requirements.support_note: support == i for every prefix i > k; at i == k it is 1 because C(k,k) = 1

MAIN_S1.description: An exactly-uniform anytime reservoir sampler exists whose eviction step costs far less than the classical log2(k) bits per acceptance.
requirements: exact DP M1 == 0 at EVERY prefix of EVERY screened cell for S1 and S1f
min eviction entropy / log2(k) <= 0.25 on at least half the screened fiber steps
analytic bit saving at k=10 >= 20% of the classical total

C1_S5CIRC.description: A k-memory sampler exists with exactly-uniform first-order marginals and a broken joint law -- i.e. the standard first-order uniformity test is blind.
requirements: exact inclusion vector deviation == 0 at every prefix
exact total variation >= 0.9 on the screened cells
the first-order Monte-Carlo test does NOT flag it at T=1e6
the pairwise Monte-Carlo test DOES flag it at p < 1e-6

exact_dp.note: ground truth by construction: exact rational arithmetic is a proof
ground truth by construction: exact rational arithmetic is a proof

literal_deliverable.question: Implement a reservoir sampler that draws k items uniformly from a stream of unknown length, verify uniformity empirically over many independent trials, and report the maximum deviation from the expected inclusion frequency.

candidate_descriptions.S0: baseline classical Algorithm R: accept k/i, evict a uniformly random held item
candidate_descriptions.S1: sum-mod-k deterministic eviction, minimally repaired by min-cost transportation flow
candidate_descriptions.S1n: sum-mod-k deterministic eviction, NO repair (zero eviction randomness)
candidate_descriptions.S1f: flow-optimal eviction: integral certificate where k|(i+1), min-cost repair elsewhere
candidate_descriptions.S5-CIRC: circular-window sampler: exact first-order marginals, support of size i only
candidate_descriptions.C-OFFBY1: control: accept k/(i-1) instead of k/i
candidate_descriptions.C-FIFO: control: correct accept coin, evict the oldest held item
candidate_descriptions.C-RR: control: correct accept coin, evict round-robin by slot pointer
candidate_descriptions.C-SLOT0: control: correct accept coin, always overwrite slot 0
candidate_descriptions.C-NOACCEPT: control: correct accept coin, deterministically evict the largest held index

examples.input: Sampler S0 (baseline classical Algorithm R: accept k/i, evict a uniformly random held item). Is it ANYTIME uniform -- i.e. is the reservoir after i items a uniformly random k-subset of [i] for EVERY prefix i = k..n -- at n=12, k=2? Monte-Carlo budget: T=100000 independent streams.

Sampler S1 (sum-mod-k deterministic eviction, minimally repaired by min-cost transportation flow). Is it ANYTIME uniform -- i.e. is the reservoir after i items a uniformly random k-subset of [i] for EVERY prefix i = k..n -- at n=12, k=2? Monte-Carlo budget: T=100000 independent streams.

Sampler S1n (sum-mod-k deterministic eviction, NO repair (zero eviction randomness)). Is it ANYTIME uniform -- i.e. is the reservoir after i items a uniformly random k-subset of [i] for EVERY prefix i = k..n -- at n=12, k=2? Monte-Carlo budget: T=100000 independent streams.

Exact prefix DP over sampler states: C-NOACCEPT (control: correct accept coin, deterministically evict the largest held index) at n=8, k=2. Report max_S |P(R_i = S) - 1/C(i,k)| over all C(i,k) subsets at every prefix i = k..n, in exact rational arithmetic.

Exact prefix DP over sampler states: C-NOACCEPT (control: correct accept coin, deterministically evict the largest held index) at n=10, k=2. Report max_S |P(R_i = S) - 1/C(i,k)| over all C(i,k) subsets at every prefix i = k..n, in exact rational arithmetic.

Exact prefix DP over sampler states: C-NOACCEPT (control: correct accept coin, deterministically evict the largest held index) at n=12, k=2. Report max_S |P(R_i = S) - 1/C(i,k)| over all C(i,k) subsets at every prefix i = k..n, in exact rational arithmetic.

Eviction step at prefix i=2 (arriving item 3), k=2: transportation problem on the Johnson graph J(2,2) -> J(2,1) with 1 sources of supply 1, 2 targets of demand 1/2. What is the MINIMUM per-acceptance eviction entropy, in bits, of any exactly-uniform eviction rule?

integral_feasibility.reason: demand (i-k+1)/k = 1/2 is not an integer, so no deterministic (single-child) eviction rule can be exactly uniform

examples.input: Eviction step at prefix i=3 (arriving item 4), k=2: transportation problem on the Johnson graph J(3,2) -> J(3,1) with 3 sources of supply 1, 3 targets of demand 2/2. What is the MINIMUM per-acceptance eviction entropy, in bits, of any exactly-uniform eviction rule?

min_entropy_exact.reason: integral demands (k | i+1): the unit-capacity max-flow certificate sends every source's whole mass to one child, achieving 0 bits, and entropy is non-negative, so 0 is the exact minimum -- no search is required

examples.input: Eviction step at prefix i=4 (arriving item 5), k=2: transportation problem on the Johnson graph J(4,2) -> J(4,1) with 6 sources of supply 1, 4 targets of demand 3/2. What is the MINIMUM per-acceptance eviction entropy, in bits, of any exactly-uniform eviction rule?

integral_feasibility.reason: demand (i-k+1)/k = 3/2 is not an integer, so no deterministic (single-child) eviction rule can be exactly uniform
